3956.title: Host interruption omits parent delivery
3956.rootCauseOneLine: Bulk host interruption records child terminal events but never queues the parent outcome batch.
3956.proposedFix: Queue non-manual interruption outcomes after commit, define structured reason/cause metadata and preserve per-turn duplicate suppression.
3956.caveats: No live disconnect experiment; no automatic fix because structured parent metadata needs a schema/contract decision.
